text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle asked me to watch her dance 
lesson, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's start the show! Trainer, let's 
dance!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! Dancing with everyone is so much 
fun, after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Are you ready? OK then! Music, start~!

And so, just going with the flow, I 
started dancing together with Taiki 
Shuttle—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Dancing together with Trainer-san 
is so much fun, yes~!
choice_data_list:
A-As long as you had fun, that's what 
matters...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, huh? Trainer, could you perhaps 
be... tired, yes...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really?! I am soo happy! Let us dance 
more and more!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"This studio is our dance floor! There is 
nothing here to get in our way!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Here we gooo~! Now, hit the musicâª

After that, Taiki Shuttle and I danced 
together until right before curfew.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, was that a bit too sudden? Sorry! 
Next, let's dance slowly!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So Trainer, please just follow my lead♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Weeell... for the opening melody, first 
you snap your arms out like this—

Taiki Shuttle's choreography lesson seemed 
to have ultimately helped improve her own 
technique as well.
